question.text: A Merchant Banker appointed for a Cat III AIF SHALL NOT be:

answer.text: An associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 79 of the source states that a merchant banker appointed by the fund shall not be an associate of the AIF, its sponsor, manager or trustee. This independence requirement is the binding rule. The Trap: Being a SEBI-registered intermediary and acting as a due-diligence agent describe the merchant banker's role; public/private status is unrelated. Note: When appointing the merchant banker, verify it is not an associate of the AIF, sponsor, manager or trustee.
